record.name: Beast Warden

talent_tree_theme.background_diorama: A serene, sun-dappled clearing in the ancient forests of Kashyyyk or the plains of Dantooine.
talent_tree_theme.node_style: Soft, glowing orbs that resemble motes of light or fireflies.
talent_tree_theme.connection_style: Flowing, gentle streams of green and gold Force energy.

record.narrative: While others seek mastery over the Force's influence on machines or politics, the Beast Warden seeks harmony with the galaxy's living creatures. They are empaths and protectors, forging deep, symbiotic bonds with animal companions through the Living Force. A Warden and their bonded beast are a single, coordinated entity, a perfect fusion of instinct and intellect, dedicated to defending the natural world and those who cannot defend themselves.
record.flavor_text: 'The beast does not serve me. We serve each other. And together, we serve the Force.' - Jedi Master Raan

class_identity_profile.core_fantasy: An empathic guardian who forms protective, symbiotic bonds with beasts, acting as a mediator between civilization and the wild.
famous_exemplars: Jedi beast riders of the Old Republic

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Portray the Beast Warden as patient and empathetic, often speaking for their animal companion. They should be a voice of reason and compassion, but act with decisive, protective fury when their allies or the natural world are threatened. Their actions are always in concert with their bonded beast.
narrative_hooks: A rare, legendary beast is being hunted by poachers; the Warden must commune and lead it to safety.
A planet's ecosystem is being poisoned by a corrupt corporation, driving wildlife into frenzy; broker peace.
A rival (perhaps an 'Apex Predator') attempts to corrupt the companion or break the bond through the dark side.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: The Warden and their companion operate as a single unit. Use combined actions to control space, protect allies, and create flanks. Prioritize support and control over raw damage.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A guardian of the natural world, attuned to the emotions of all living creatures.

progression_tree.description: You gain a boost to your Armor Class, making you harder to hit in combat.
You form a deep bond with the creatures you protect, granting you insight into their emotions and thoughts.
You can summon a shield of swirling animal spirits to protect you from harm.
You gain a heightened sense of awareness, allowing you to detect hidden enemies and track down fleeing foes.
You become a powerful force for good in the natural world, capable of summoning ancient powers to aid you in combat.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a formidable stance, feet shoulder-width apart, with arms crossed over the chest, radiating an aura of serene intensity.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounds itself in a gentle, pulsing glow, reminiscent of the soft luminescence of a forest at dawn, reflecting its harmony with nature.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Depict the Beast Warden standing before a tranquil glade, surrounded by towering trees and vibrant wildflowers, while conveying its innate connection to the natural world through expressive body language.
contextual_modifiers: Include subtle hints of mist and morning dew on the surrounding foliage
Depict the Beast Warden's eyes as pools of deep, soothing blue, reflecting its compassion and wisdom
